subject.title: [Enhancement] Prepared Statement Compilation Overhead in executeCompiledSqliteQuerySync (Kysely Sync Facade)

question: Should the unreleased synchronous SQLite facade gain a bounded prepared-statement cache now, or should implementation wait for a representative Node 22 benchmark showing material OpenClaw benefit?
rationale: Source inspection proves repeated preparation but cannot determine the performance threshold at which added cache state and invalidation complexity are worthwhile.

options.title: Require benchmark first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a representative Node 22 benchmark or profile before implementing statement caching.

options.title: Sponsor bounded cache now
options.body: Treat the source-level overhead as sufficient and implement a small bounded per-database LRU with explicit lifecycle and schema-change tests.

recommendation.title: Require benchmark first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a representative Node 22 benchmark or profile before implementing statement caching.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the focused facade hardening and have recent ownership signals in the same shared SQLite lifecycle area.
